text: หลิ่วซีของพวกเรา
style: Speak natural standard Central Thai (Bangkok) as a native Thai voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm and polite particles only where written. A 65-year-old old village head, male: aged, gentle but weighty, speaks slowly, every sentence certain. Line direction (written in Chinese; never read it aloud, speak only the Thai line): 激動，極短促，一口氣說完，不拖音
